div.head: II As 12
div.ab: Be ðon ðe mon ne ceapige butan porte. We cwædon be ðon þæt mon nænne ceape ne ceapige butan porte ofer XX peninga; ac ceapige þær binnan on ðæs portgerefan gewitnysse oþþe oþres ungeligenes mannes, oþþe eft on ðæra gerefena gewitnysse on folcmote.

Ond we cwædon, þæt mon nænne ceap ne geceapige buton porte ofer XX penega; ac ceapige ðær binnon on þæs portgerefan gewitnesse oððe on oþres unlygnes monnes, oððe eft on þara gerefena gewitnesse on folcgemote.

[Be þon þe mon ne ceapige butan ðam port. We cwædon, þæt mon nænne ceap ne ceapige buton porte] ofer XX peninga; ac ceapige þær binnan on þæs portgerefan gewitnesse oððe oþres ungeligenes mannes oþþe eft on þæra gerefena gewitnesse on folcgemote.

Ne quis negocietur extra portum. Et diximus: nullus (ne quis) emat aliquid extra ciuitatem (uel portum) supra XX den.; sed in ea (eo) barganiet sub testimonio portireue uel alterius credibilis hominis; aut (uel) item in testimonio prepositorum in folkesimote.

[Be ðon ðe mon ne ceapige butan porte.] [Ld] Ond we cwædon, þæt mon nænne ceap ne geceapige buton porte ofer XX penega; ac ceapige ðær binnon on þæs portgerefan gewitnesse oððe on oþres unlygnes monnes, oððe eft on þara gerefena gewitnesse on folcgemote.

And we have declared that no one shall buy goods worth more than 20 pence, outside a town; but he shall buy within the town, in the presence of the port-reeve or some other trustworthy man, or again, in the presence of the reeve at a public meeting.

(Darüber, dass man ausserhalb der Stadt nicht Handel treibe. So Ld) Und wir bestimmten, dass man keinen Kauf über [den Werth von] 20 Pfennigen hinaus ausserhalb der Stadt verhandle; sondern man handle darinnen unter Zeugniss des Stadtvogts oder eines anderen wahrhaften Mannes, oder späterhin unter Zeugniss der Vögte in der Volksversammlung.

(That no one trade outside a town. So Ld) And we determined that no one is to transact any purchase over [the value of] 20 pence outside a town; but let him trade within it under the witness of the town-reeve or of another truthful man, or later under the witness of the reeves in the public assembly.
div.note: H leaves space for a heading here and before the following chapters. Liebermann compares I Ew 1.
